title: BBC Learning English from the News 2026 — Quiz 14
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q131_double_edged_sword
elements.title: Living near the station is a ___: the commute is easy, but the trains are noisy.

elements.name: q132_rebuke
elements.title: The chair issued a sharp ___ after a member interrupted several speakers.

elements.name: q133_harrowing
elements.title: The survivor gave a ___ account of the ordeal, leaving many listeners upset.

elements.name: q134_thirsty_for
elements.title: After years of delay, the fans were ___ news of a release date.

elements.name: q135_weigh
elements.title: Before deciding, the committee will ___ the costs and benefits of each option.

elements.name: q136_someone_s_fate_lies_with_someone_or_something
elements.title: “The team's fate lies with the panel.” What does this mean?
choices: The team will vote on the panel's future.
The team's future is already secure.
The panel cannot influence the outcome.
The team's future depends on what the panel decides.
elements.correctAnswer: The team's future depends on what the panel decides.

elements.name: q137_thorny
elements.title: How to divide limited funding fairly is a ___ issue with no simple answer.

elements.name: q138_plunge_someone_or_something_into_uncertainty
elements.title: The unexpected resignation could ___ the organisation into uncertainty about its future.

elements.name: q139_bode_well
elements.title: Which form fits “Her quick response ___ well for the rest of the project”?

elements.name: q140_lose_contact_with
elements.title: Which preposition fits “We lost contact ___ each other after graduation”?
